name: Exposed Spring Boot Heap Dump
title: Publicly Downloadable JVM Memory Heap Dump (/actuator/heapdump)
description: The Spring Boot Actuator heapdump endpoint allows anonymous downloading of server RAM, which contains decrypted passwords, cryptographic keys, and cached tokens.
remediation: Disable the heapdump actuator endpoint in application.properties by setting 'management.endpoint.heapdump.enabled=false'.
